title: Formality of arbitrary module families on finite clopen rank strata
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $g:(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to(Y,i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ be [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Choose a derived category over $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant with finite image, and $U_m=\{r=m\}$ be [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. For each $m\geq0$ let $E_m$ be an arbitrary module sheaf on $U_m$. Let $T^n=j_{n,*}E_n$ for $n\geq0$, and $T^n=0$ for $n<0$. Let $C$ be the zero-differential complex with terms $T^n$. If $K\in D(i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ has module-sheaf isomorphisms $H^n(K)\cong g_*T^n$ for all $n$, then $Q(g_*C)\cong K$, where $g_*$ is applied termwise [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No derived direct image or exterior power is involved.

proof.text: Glue 1 on a clopen fiber U_m and 0 on its complement. Push these sections to i_*O_Z. Their multiplication endomorphisms are orthogonal idempotents with finite sum 1. They split every representative complex termwise into image subcomplexes, preserving differentials, homology and quasi-isomorphisms.

The direct image of E_m is supported on the rank-m summand. The algebra-linear homology isomorphisms commute with multiplication by the characteristic idempotents. Each summand of K therefore has homology in its assigned single degree only. Canonical truncations identify it with that homology sheaf placed in that degree. Perform the same truncation on the termwise pushed-forward zero-differential complex.

Sum the finitely many single-degree isomorphisms and compose with the termwise splitting isomorphisms. Off the closed image the algebra is zero, so all its module sheaves vanish. The empty source gives zero on both sides; rank zero gives degree zero. The argument never requires the rank strata to be clopen in Y.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenRankStrata_formality
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ) (hfinite : (Set.range r).Finite)
    (E : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).toScheme.Modules)
    (T : ℤ → Z.Modules)
    (hT : ∀ n : ℤ, T n = if 0 ≤ n then
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n.toNat).ι).obj
        (E n.toNat) else 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj K ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T n))) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (CochainComplex.of T (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => zero_comp))) ≅ K)
